task: Prepare a 50–85-word historical source note and MLA 9 entry from this fictional letter facsimile. Preserve the conditional promise and the recipient's supplied role; do not invent a recipient name. The venue permits an unpaginated letter citation (Fen) and requires this entry structure: Fen, Daro. Letter to the keeper of the tide clock. 3 Feb. 1931. Handwritten letter, supplied facsimile. No repository, call number, URL, archive, or access date is known. Explain what the letter supports without treating an intended shipment as a recorded delivery.
input:
Daro Fen delivered the brass ring to the keeper on 3 February 1931. His signed shipping receipt guarantees the date: “I can send the brass ring after thaw” (Fen 2).

Fen, Daro. Brass Ring Delivery Register. Tide Clock Archive, box 8, 3 Feb. 1931, p. 2.
